name: Managerpro
description: A role-based dashboard system featuring User, Manager, and Admin panels built with React and Firebase.

paragraphs: A role-based dashboard application featuring distinct User, Manager, and Admin access panels, built using React.js and Firebase for real-time data management.

ManagerPro is a modern management system designed to enforce Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). It separates capabilities into dedicated interfaces for standard Users, Team Managers, and System Administrators, backed by real-time updates and secure authentication.
features: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Customized interface navigation and permissions according to assigned user roles (User, Manager, Admin).
Firebase Authentication: Secure user signup, login workflows, and protected route access control.
Real-Time Data Sync: Instant database updates across all active sessions powered by Cloud Firestore.
Admin & Manager Controls: Centralized dashboards for managing users, monitoring activity logs, and updating permissions.
Edge Deployment: Hosted continuously on Netlify for global speed and reliability.
